LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 5.1.1 EXPRESSING SELF CREATIVELY

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.1: Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Expressing Self Creatively
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Expressing Self Creatively, part of Strand 5 in Grade 5 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How do we use language creatively? 2. What is the importance of creative language?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work jointly with peers to use adjectives to describe events and experiences based on the theme creatively,

2. watch recorded clips of narratives and identify creative expressions and language elements,

3. conduct a storytelling session with peers based on the theme,

4. listen to each other’s stories and pick out creative language elements such as proverbs, wise sayings and idioms,

5. brainstorm the meanings of commonly used proverbs, sayings and idioms with peers,

6. collaborate with peers to come up with an oral narrative on events at the market using creative language, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work jointly with peers to use adjectives to describe events and experiences based on the theme creatively,
2. watch recorded clips of narratives and identify creative expressions and language elements,
3. conduct a storytelling session with peers based on the theme,
4. listen to each other’s stories and pick out creative language elements such as proverbs, wise sayings and idioms,
5. brainstorm the meanings of commonly used proverbs, sayings and idioms with peers,
6. collaborate with peers to come up with an oral narrative on events at the market using creative language, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Expressing Self Creatively together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and Problem solving: This is enhanced as the learner explores views when brainstorming the meanings of

commonly used proverbs, sayings and idioms with peers.

• Creativity and Imagination: This is developed as the learner exchanges new ideas that inspire creative thinking when

composing their own oral narratives using creative language.

Values:
• Responsibility: This is developed as the learner offers guidance to peers when building a collection of proverbs, idioms and

wise sayings and displaying in class.

• Unity: This is enhanced as the learner appreciates the efforts of others when conducting a storytelling session with peers

based on the theme.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social awareness: This is enhanced as learner interacts with peers when conducting story telling sessions on the theme.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the concept of creative language skills in narration to their learning of performance in Creative Arts.
